meta.title: Betting slips: record, share and track your picks | Puntr
meta.description: Add a betting slip by typing it, pasting it or uploading a photo. Review it, then publish its legs as time-stamped Puntr picks.

title: Betting slips
subtitle: Record a slip you placed with a bookmaker. Review every detail, then publish its legs as time-stamped picks that count on your record.
signIn: Sign in to add and track your slips.

empty.mine: You haven't added a slip yet.

source.title: How do you want to add it?
source.manualHint: Enter the matches and selections yourself.
source.textHint: Copy the slip from your bookmaker's app or site.
source.imageHint: A screenshot or photo. It's read on your device.

paste.label: Slip text
paste.placeholder:
Paste the slip here, e.g.
Kaizer Chiefs v Orlando Pirates
Match Result: Kaizer Chiefs @ 2.40

photo.privacy: Your photo is read on this device. Only the text, with personal details removed, is used to fill in the form. Cover your account name, balance and ID before uploading. Photos are private to you and deleted after 30 days.

removed_one: We removed {{count}} personal detail before reading the slip.
removed_other: We removed {{count}} personal details before reading the slip.

review.title: Check your slip
review.hint: Fix anything that was read wrongly. Legs linked to a Puntr fixture with a supported market become picks when you publish; other legs are tracked on the slip only.
review.bookmakerPrivate: Only you can see the bookmaker.
review.showStake: Show my stake and return on the published slip
review.notePlaceholder: Why you like these picks (280 characters)

issues.too_many_legs: A slip can have up to 30 legs.
issues.leg_teams: Every leg needs a home and an away team.
issues.leg_selection: Choose a selection for every leg with a market.
issues.stake: Enter a stake between R0.01 and R1 000 000, or leave it empty.

card.confirmDelete: Delete this slip? Published picks stay on your record.
card.picksNote: Picks that came from this slip are settled with every other Puntr pick.

done.draft: Saved as a draft. Only you can see it.
done.published_one: Published. {{count}} pick was added to your record.
done.published_other: Published. {{count}} picks were added to your record.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.empty: We couldn't find any slip text. Try another photo or paste the text.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't read a bet from that. Check the text or type the slip in.
errors.image_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.image_size: That image is too large. Try a screenshot instead.
errors.ocr: We couldn't read the photo on this device. Paste the text or type the slip instead.
errors.daily_limit: You've reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.slip_empty: Add at least one leg before publishing.
errors.slip_published: A published slip can't be changed.
errors.bad_image_path: The photo couldn't be attached. Please try again.
errors.kickoff_passed: A match on this slip has already kicked off, so it can't become a pick. Mark that leg as not on Puntr or save as a draft.
errors.fixture_not_open: A match on this slip isn't open for picks.
errors.not_launched: Picks open when Puntr launches. You can save the slip as a draft now.
errors.age_not_attested: Confirm that you're 18 or older in your account to publish picks.
errors.posting_paused: Your picks are paused while you're on a break.
errors.duplicate: You already have a pick on one of these matches and markets.
